question: Which of the following cultural festivals is organised by the Uttar Pradesh tourism department?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taj Mahotsav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Taj Mahotsav 2024 is scheduled to take place from February 17th to 27th.
 
• Location: It is being organized at Shilpgram in Agra, near the Taj Mahal, known for its historical significance.
 
• Celebration: The festival is dedicated to honoring the enduring love story of Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan and Mumtaz.
 
• Cultural Showcase: Taj Mahotsav aims to showcase the talents of local artists, craftspeople, culinary experts, and performers from Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Inaugural Edition: The first Taj Mahotsav took place in 1992, and the upcoming event marks its 32nd edition.
 
• Department of Tourism: The festival is orchestrated by the Department of Tourism to promote cultural heritage and tourism.
 
• Mughal-style Procession: It features an annual Mughal-style procession, adding to the grandeur of the event.
 
• Artisan Participation: Scores of local artisans from diverse regions of India converge to exhibit their craftsmanship.
 
• Cultural Diversity: Expect to witness various art forms, cuisines, and performances representing the cultural diversity of India.
 
• Artistic Expressions: Visitors can experience unique creations such as marble and zardozi decor items, chikankari dresses, silk sarees, and intricately carved wooden pieces.
